children: Rezolute reported a net loss of $77.6 million for fiscal year 2026 and $20.5 million for the fourth quarter ended June 30, 2026, with cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaling $107.8 million at year-end. Research and development expense for FY2026 was $53.8 million and general and administrative expense was $29.2 million. The company provided operational updates on its Phase 3 upLIFT study in tumor hyperinsulinism and ongoing regulatory review and open-label extension activity for the congenital HI sunRIZE study.
Net loss: $77.6 million for fiscal year ended June 30, 2026; net loss of $20.5 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Research and development expense: $53.8 million for FY2026; $14.9 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
General and administrative expense: $29.2 million for FY2026; $6.7 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Cash, cash equivalents and investments in marketable securities: $107.8 million as of June 30, 2026 (cash and cash equivalents $10.6 million; marketable debt securities $97.2 million).
Total operating expenses: $82.966 million for FY2026; loss from operations $(82.966) million for FY2026.
upLIFT (Phase 3, single-arm, open-label) for tumor hyperinsulinism is ongoing with enrollment in progress and topline results expected before the end of 2026.

Interim upLIFT data (June 2026): of eight enrolled participants, six met the primary endpoint responder criterion within the 8-week pivotal treatment phase and discontinued intravenous glucose; a seventh participant later met the responder criterion.
One enrolled upLIFT participant with advanced metastatic cancer withdrew and transitioned to hospice prior to completing the pivotal phase and is counted as a non-responder for the primary endpoint.

Rezolute presented tumor HI case series data at ENDO and published a manuscript in JCEM reporting that 75% of nine EAP patients receiving IV dextrose/TPN achieved complete discontinuation of IV dextrose/TPN with ersodetug.

sunRIZE (Phase 3 in congenital HI) did not meet its primary endpoint; Rezolute has submitted supplemental datasets and analyses to the FDA, the open-label extension is ongoing with high participation and indicators of improved glycemic control, and the company is awaiting regulatory feedback.
